extensions.documentationNote: Native egui components have no HTML/CSS runtime. Native component records replace web snippets; no HTML/CSS design detector applies. No invented tonal ramps or motion values are added.

nativeSettings.save: Save settings and Save custom theme validate, apply and persist the custom draft.
nativeSettings.settingsThemeSelection: Built-in and saved-theme choices apply immediately; Save settings persists them.
nativeSettings.headerThemeToggle: Applies and persists light/dark mode while preserving custom colors and the editor draft. Use default colors explicitly restores the built-in palette.
nativeSettings.transfer: Settings export omits customThemes and activeCustomTheme for compatibility with older version-1 transfers; separate theme JSON transfers custom colors.
nativeSettings.importPreservation: An empty or absent custom-theme collection preserves the local collection; an omitted API key preserves the local key.

nativeDiscovery.theme: Existing light/dark roles; no new color tokens.
nativeDiscovery.navigation: My mods and Browse mods below the logo; browser uses the full central panel without the library rail.

layout.shortWindow: Below 600 points of content height, everything below the browser heading scrolls together.
layout.projectScroll: Back to results remains above the scroll region.

states.cardHoverAndFocus: Existing selection stroke inside the 8-point card border when hovered or focused.
states.search: Search or Enter submits; category and sort changes restart at index zero.
states.counts: Provider pagination supplies result count, range and Previous/Next availability.
states.setup: Connect to CurseForge with Open Settings and instructions to save a local API key.
states.error: Search unavailable with provider-specific guidance, Open Settings and Try again.
states.categoryError: Visible warning; available projects remain shown.
states.return: Back to results or Escape restores the current page; Ctrl+F returns to browser search.

nativeDiscovery.scope: Provider search and in-app inspection only; no downloads, updates, metadata writes or source attachments. Requests use the saved local key.

narrative.overview:
The native library follows the user-approved Deadlock Mod Manager and CurseForge direction. Large previews carry recognition; warm neutral surfaces, gold selection and visible installed state keep local management clear. The light and dark themes share the same hierarchy.

This design applies to the Linux Fastframe/egui app. The Rust implementation is authoritative. Dimensions use egui logical points, not CSS pixels. Fastframe supplies default fonts and platform text rendering.
keyCharacteristics: Photo cards by default, with a compact list switch.
Warm light and charcoal dark themes with gold selection.
A persistent inspector on wide windows and a return path on narrow windows.

rules.name: readable metadata
rules.body: Use the explicit muted theme color for secondary text; do not substitute egui's default weak alpha for it.

dos: Do preserve photo proportions with destination-aware centered cover crops in cards and contain sizing in the inspector.
Do keep explicit weak text colors readable on panels, cards, widgets and selected fills.
Do preserve search and selected identity when switching card/list layouts.
Do show No Preview for missing or broken mod photos and keep weak source-match warnings visible.
donts: Don't fabricate mod photography, authors, source candidates or discovery counters.
Don't add download or update actions to this local management library.
Don't replace native focus and hover behavior with a custom selection animation.
